pain_point: Worried about Truganina infrastructure - Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there? Roads parking services?
primary_text: "Is the infrastructure keeping up with development out there?" Here's what's been delivered: the West Gate Tunnel, upgraded Princes Freeway interchanges, new arterial roads through Truganina's industrial precinct, and purpose-built estate infrastructure including truck turning areas, drainage, and commercial-grade services. Billions in government spending have transformed Melbourne's western corridor into a serious industrial hub. These aren't promises — they're completed or in-progress projects you can see today. New off-the-plan warehouses in Truganina benefit from infrastructure that older industrial areas in the inner west can only dream of. Wider roads, better access, modern design. Visit the estate this week.
description: New estate infrastructure surpasses older inner-west industrial areas
